_note: PLACEHOLDER — names, icons and stats are Claude-invented. v0 ships exactly three enemy types (design-brief-v0: 'enemy variety beyond 3 types' is explicitly out of scope). Each one needs a stable id because the encounter-flag registry (DiscoveryLog) keys off it. 'sightRadius' is how far this creature notices you from. Two is the baseline; later creatures are expected to see further, which is why it lives on the creature rather than in Tuning.
